blocks.x: George William Mitchell is our name.
Just where were you born? In Louisville, Kentucky. What was the date? Oh, 1899. You have the exact birth date? 8th of March. 8th of March, 1899. So you're just about 50... 60.
Oh, that's right, yes. In March. You don't look old at all.
Well, sometimes I feel pretty old.
